population.definition: games with at least one team in that season's /teams/fbs

replay.historical_reason: CFBD history was first retrieved in 2026; no archived-publication evidence exists for 2014-2025 facts, so strict replay is not available historically

calibration.if_calibration_disabled: score_frozen_stack_as_validation; may halt promotion; may not refit weights or hyperparameters

test.after_opening: archive_result; future confirmation uses a new prospective period

folds.postseason: one fold per season (CFBD postseason week 1 spans mid-December to January)
folds.fold_cutoff: minimum game_cutoff among the fold's games
folds.parameter_fit_rule: parameters used in a fold are fit only on data available at or before that fold's cutoff
folds.state_update_rule: filtered states may add results available at or before each game's own cutoff
folds.minimum_refit_cadence: every stage refit at least at each season's first fold; refitting more often is allowed
folds.start_time_tbd: use scheduled date with provider placeholder time and flag the game

products.reconstructed_horizon_note: with no timestamped intra-week information, 24h and 60m reconstructed forecasts may coincide; report them separately anyway

market_informed.historical_evaluation: none; historical lines lack observation timestamps (D01 finding 1)

game_joint.estimator: all draws for E||X-y||; split-pairing of the same draws for 0.5 E||X-X'||

metrics.models_without_joint_scores: scored on winner, margin and total only; cannot be compared on the promotion metric
metrics.initial_champion_requirement: the initial champion must emit paired final-score samples

comparison.unit: per-game paired difference (challenger minus champion) on the same games, horizon and replay class
comparison.superiority_rule: upper bound of the 95% interval of mean paired energy-score difference is below 0
comparison.other_test_comparisons: reported as secondary; no superiority claims

reported_for_every_evaluation.definition: regular-season game where either team has played fewer than 3 games that season before kickoff
no drives, or drive reconciliation kind other than match

pending_registration_before_results.requires: portal coverage audit by season (not yet done)

cohorts.small_cohorts: publish counts and uncertainty without a definitive gate

reconstructed_market_spread.line: median spread across books present for the game
reconstructed_market_spread.distribution: margin centered at minus spread, scale fit past-only on training seasons
reconstructed_market_spread.label: reconstructed benchmark of unknown line timing; descriptive only, no superiority claims

reconstructed_open_spread.label: reconstructed; opening lines absent before 2021 (D02 finding 1); never pooled with the 2014-2020 benchmark

benchmarks.games_without_comparable_line: reported as a count, never dropped silently

sensitivity: FBS-only training versus retained FCS opponents
history decay variants registered before their results

monte_carlo.seed_derivation: sha256 of root_seed, protocol_version, model_id, game_id and horizon
monte_carlo.parallel_execution: games and folds may be simulated in parallel; each game's draws depend only on its derived seed, so results must be identical for any worker count or order
monte_carlo.convergence_check: repeat at double draws for games within 0.02 of a decision boundary

short_history_modules.rule: each module registers its own seasons, folds and metrics in this file before any of its results are seen
